items.question: Has the firm assessed the integrity of the client's owners and management, and recorded the basis for accepting or continuing the relationship?
Do the preconditions for an audit exist, including an acceptable reporting framework and management's acknowledgement of its responsibilities?
Has each engagement team member and the engagement partner confirmed independence, and has the firm recorded any threats identified and the safeguards applied?
Does the firm have the competence, time and resources to perform this engagement, including any specialist input needed?
Has a signed engagement letter covering scope, framework, responsibilities and reporting been obtained?
Have client identification and anti-money-laundering checks been completed and filed?
Has a conflicts check across the firm's other clients been performed and the outcome recorded?
For a continuing client, have prior-year issues and any change in auditor communications been considered, and for a new client, has the predecessor auditor been contacted?
Has the firm determined whether this engagement requires an engagement quality review, and recorded the decision?
